name: mcpm
description: Minecraft Package Manager - CLI mod manager powered by Modrinth API

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build --prefix features/launcher
scripts.build:test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run build:test
scripts.check: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.type-tests.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit

author: Maciej Wlodarski
